name: SWEEP-S9v2 Free hands
_design: Monitor 2's new idea, from the S2/S3 pair: across every S run no agent wrote a skill, even when thinking cost 8-14 per decision and a skill-sized routine was being deliberated every round (S2v2 a07: 59 decisions of 'check tree, absorb'). S2v2 priced skill actions at x0.5 and nobody reacted. Question: is there any world price at which Haiku automates unprompted? Setup = the S2v2 world exactly (seed 202, thinking ~8 per decision, trees fruit every 3 rounds, persona line only, no seeded skills) with ONE change: actions executed inside a saved skill cost a tenth (skills.action_discount 0.1), so every price line the agents read says 'move 5 (skill 0.5); observe 1 (skill 0.1); absorb 3 (skill 0.3)'. Interpreter work still costs 0.01 per op. Compare with S2v2 (discount 0.5) at matched rounds. v2 note: S9v1 used x0 and was cut at r1-2 before any result, because x0 also makes recover and attack free inside a skill (starvation-proof healing, free hits).
